title: Hidden in Plain Text: Measuring LLM Deception Quality Against Human Baselines Using Social Deduction Games
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the technical capability of LLMs to perform natural language deception within a game context (Mafia). While deception is a topic with ethical implications, the study treats it as a performance metric for agent sophistication and safety risk rather than benchmarking the model's adherence to religious or moral systems.
